A letter to my Bee

Read this slowly, like I would say it if you were right here.

For Madhu, always

Dearest Madhu,

I want to say what I feel. Simply. Without searching too hard for the right words.

Being with you again feels like we never really left — like those five years somehow folded quietly and we are back to where we were. Back to us.

At the start of this year, you came back. You came to say goodbye — and yet, here you are. Still here. I don't know if that's luck or love, but I choose to believe it's love. Our love. The kind that doesn't let go even when it's supposed to.

I want this life, Madhu. The one where you are beside me. Where we love each other, argue sometimes, and still choose each other every morning. I want all of it — the ordinary days, the long years, everything still waiting for us.

This feels like a blessing I didn't earn but somehow received. Like God quietly placed you back into my hands and said — try again.

I sleep inside your dreams. I wake up with your name on my lips. Wherever I look, I find some trace of you — in the morning, in the evening, in the small moments I can't even explain.

So stay a little longer.
Stay until a little longer becomes forever.

Yours,
Kartik. ♡

And now, the wish I've been saving for last

Happy Birthday,my dear Princess.

Happy birthday, Madhu. May this year be gentle with your heart, generous with your dreams, and full of reasons to laugh until your cheeks hurt. May you always feel seen, cherished, and loved—not just today, but in all the ordinary tomorrows too. And may the little girl you once were always know how deeply she deserves happiness.

Five years, a thousand feelings, and still—my heart says you. Here's to more memories, more growing, more choosing each other. Stay a little longer, Bee. ♡

With all my love,

Kartik
